title: Doctor Appointment Scheduling System
highlights: Admin-only paradigm — patients book/reschedule entirely via AI phone calls, staff never touch a phone
Provider-agnostic voice layer via a VoiceProviderAdapter interface (Vapi live, Dograh self-hosted as secondary)
Single FastAPI backend serving both the dashboard API and voice-provider webhooks, deployed on one VPS
shortDesc: A clinic scheduling platform where patients book appointments over AI-powered phone calls and staff manage everything through a web dashboard.
fullDesc: This system replaces the phone-and-spreadsheet workflow at small clinics with an AI-first booking flow: patients call in and speak to a Vapi-powered voice agent that checks doctor availability, books or reschedules appointments, and logs the call, while clinic staff manage doctors, schedules, and patients through a Next.js admin dashboard. A single FastAPI backend handles both the dashboard's REST API and inbound voice-provider webhooks, backed by a PostgreSQL schema (15 tables, 26 FKs) designed for multi-clinic tenancy from the start. A VoiceProviderAdapter abstraction keeps the system decoupled from any one voice AI vendor, with Vapi as the primary provider and the open-source Dograh stack integrated unmodified as a secondary option.
